title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00081 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling
excerpt:
00:00 - 07:00: Continued repairing leakage on aft PRS. Meanwhile started to repair FWD PRS
07:00 - 15:15: Continued repairing both PRS'S. Function tested aft PRS and confirmed no leakages. Pulled electrical cable through drag chain on FWD PRS. Meanwhile performed drops inspection on aft PRS.
15:15 - 15:30: Performed TBT for handling guns and perforating 13 3/8" casing below CH
15:30 - 16:15: M/u perforation guns
16:15 - 16:45: RIH restricted w/ guns to 140 mmd, 2min/std.
16:45 - 17:30: M/u TDS and spaced out to have top gun at 143,3mmd. Closed UPR and confirmed line-up. Flushed ball seat area.
17:30 - 18:00: Dropped ball. M/u pup joint and spaced out. Closed UPR and pressured up to 140 bar. Got positivie indications of fired guns, lost all pressure. Top shot at 143,3 mmd, BTM shot at 146,3 mmd.
18:00 - 18:45: Circulated at 450 LPM until returns. Staged up flow to 1000 LPM 5 bar. Circulated 1 x b/u, no gas observed, 5ppm h2s in gas trap after pumps was stopped.
18:45 - 19:00: Flowchecked well through choke, static.
19:00 - 19:30: Opened BOP and lined up to TT. Flowchecked well, static.
19:30 - 20:00: POOH with guns from 147 mdm to 26 mmd.
20:00 - 20:45: L/d 1 5 1/2" DP single and perforation BHA
20:45 - 21:00: Cleaned and cleared drill floor meanwhile prepared to RIH with EZSV RT
21:00 - 21:15: Performed TBT for RIH with EZSV RT
21:15 - 21:30: P/u and m/u EZSV RT
21:30 - 22:30: RIH w/ EZSV RT on 5 1/2" DP from 2 mmd to 364 mmd Avg. Tripping speed 344 m/hr.
22:30 - 23:00: Removed master bushing and installed PS-21 slips
23:00 - 23:45: RIH w/ EZSV RT on 5 1/2" DP from 346 mmd to 767 mmd. Avg. Tripping speed 560 m/hr.
23:45 - 00:00: Installed 2 x pups and pump in sub. M/u pump-in sub and l/d pump-in stand.
